correctness.rationale: All 32767 nonzero 15-bit quartic forms are checked by exact seven-line polynomial squarefreeness and rational partial derivatives. There are 2559 transverse-free forms and precisely 25 rationally nonsingular candidates; an independently written binomial-expansion scanner reproduces the exact 25-mask certificate. PGL3(F2) has exactly 168 matrices, with orbits 24 and 1 covering all candidates. For all 25 forms SymPy calculates unit ideals for F and three partial derivatives on all three affine charts; the same two representative smoothness checks suffice by coordinate invariance. No extension-point truncation or numerical approximation is used.

Asgarli–Freidin (arXiv:2009.13421) prove asymptotic density statements for high degree; its inspected relevant sections lack the finite 25-form classification.
Dickson (1915) classifies modulo-two quartic types by rational points, apices and bitangents; full-text access was not achieved, so its implication strength remains unresolved.

Dickson’s much broader historical classifications may implicitly determine this result, so an originality risk remains and this result must not be presented as excluding older implicit coverage.

originality.rationale: The degree-four GF(2) transverse-free orbit dichotomy is not stated in the relevant inspected 2020 Asgarli–Freidin analysis or the 2018 sharp Bertini examples, which establish asymptotic behavior and the filling subfamily respectively. Distinct earlier classifications give the 24 filling equations and the exceptional seven-bitangent curve, but a complete exclusion of every intermediate rational-point stratum under the natural transverse-free condition was not found in accessible primary text. Originality remains qualified by historical Dickson catalogues and unindexed tables; no global uniqueness in literature is certified.

value.rationale: Degree four is the first possible degree q+2 for failure of rational-line Bertini transversality over F2. Complete exact classification of the sharp failure locus identifies a rigid all-or-none rational-point dichotomy and two fundamentally different geometric contact mechanisms: a 24-element family of rational filling curves and a 168-fold projectively invariant pointless curve with all seven lines nonsplit bitangents. This is a motivated and natural exact classification, not an arbitrary coefficient slice or numerical improvement.
